''See also: [[Silent One Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Silent One is a specialized warrior and bodyguard who serves as the protector for a Chronicler. Within the [[Witness Guild]], these two roles function as pairs; while the Chronicler is responsible for recording and transcribing history, the Silent One provides security. Members of this role are characterized by their silence, often covering their mouths with bandages or cloth as a symbolic refusal to reveal secrets. They are typically heavily armed, carrying various weapons such as whips or saws, and often wear specialized clothing like coats that can be invested with magic to provide protection against projectiles. Some highly renowned individuals are known as [[Soulbound]] [[Silent Ones]], representing a significant level of power and connection within their order.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|This warrior keeps his mouth covered as a symbolic gesture of refusing to speak secrets. He carries various weapons strapped all over his person.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Serving as a bodyguard and protector, this individual acts as an entity used by [[Naberius Clayborn]]. The role is a position held by the Heads of the [[Witness' Guild]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Service to Naberius}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Silent One serves as a warrior and bodyguard.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> As a symbol of his refusal to speak secrets, he keeps his mouth covered.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 6</ref> He was once positioned near a body dressed in black.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref> [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] utilizes this entity for protection, often accompanied by the Silent One as he limps along beside him.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Silent One|The Silent One]] is a warrior and bodyguard.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Silent One|The Silent One]] covers his mouth as a symbol of refusing to speak secrets.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Silent One|The Silent One]] is a character near whom a body in black lay.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] has a [[Silent One]] that limps along beside him.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Silent One|The Silent One]] is a protection or entity that [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] uses.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Engaging in combat with a Silent One may be a necessary part of killing a Chronicler.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref> During their movements, the creature's eyes brushed past [[Shera]]'s tunnel.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 10</ref> This entity is also associated with [[Naberius Clayborn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref>}}

<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Killing a Chronicler might involve fighting a [[Silent One]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Silent One|The Silent One]]'s eyes brushed past [[Shera]]’s tunnel.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Silent One|The Silent One]] is associated with [[Naberius Clayborn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Role within Witnesses}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Silent One serves as a specific role within the Witnesses.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref> These individuals keep their mouths covered and carry various weapons strapped across their bodies.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref> During the events, [[Silent Ones]] are present in the room.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">3</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Silent One]] is a role within the Witnesses.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Silent Ones]] keep their mouths covered and carry weapons strapped all over.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Silent Ones]] are present in the room.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The role of a Silent One is performed by the Heads of the [[Guild of Witnesses|Witness’ Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> These individuals are responsible for protecting a Chronicler.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Silent One]] is a role performed by the Heads of the [[Guild of Witnesses|Witness’ Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
